title: Twisting Within Cylinder (Polarized Light in Sugar Water)
full_prompt:
Create a 3D Manim visualization showing polarized light twisting as it passes through a sugar cylinder (representing sugar water). The scene should include:
1. A 3D coordinate system (axes and plane) aligned horizontally.
2. A semi-transparent cylinder ('SugarCylinder') representing the medium.
3. A twisted ribbon ('TwistedRibbon') representing the polarization plane twisting along the cylinder's length.
4. Multiple light waves or a mean wave propagating through the cylinder, with their polarization angles twisting.
5. A polarizer disk at the end or along the path.
Use ManimGL's 3D capabilities, including `ThreeDAxes`, `Cylinder`, `ParametricSurface`, and custom updaters for wave propagation.

common_failure_modes.pattern: 3D camera sorting issues with transparent cylinders
common_failure_modes.note: In ManimGL, transparent overlapping 3D objects require proper camera sorting or depth buffer handling. Use always_sort_to_camera.
Set set_flat_stroke(False) on 3D curves to prevent them from rendering as flat 2D lines.
